name: Shanghai Accessen Co., Ltd.
full_description: Shanghai Accessen Co., Ltd. is a heat exchange solution provider specializing in the R&D, manufacturing, sales, and service of heat exchange equipment. The company focuses on low-carbon data center solutions and broader thermal management applications across heating, refrigeration, and industrial sectors.

Its manufacturing base spans more than 100,000 square meters across the Xiechun Road factory in Shanghai and the Taicang Port Area factory. Accessen supports customers through a direct sales and service network covering major cities in China as well as overseas markets including Hong Kong, Singapore, Malaysia, and Thailand.

Accessen serves data center, HVAC, refrigeration, energy and power, steel and metallurgy, petrochemical, food and pharmaceutical, new energy electronics, marine and offshore, and environmental treatment applications. The company positions plate heat exchange and system integration as its two core technologies.

Its AS-standard product portfolio includes plate heat exchangers and units, fully welded plate-shell and plate-frame heat exchangers, fully welded air heat exchangers, process water cooling systems, waste heat recovery systems, and prefabricated integrated cooling stations. The company states compliance with international standards and certifications including ASME, CE, AHRI, API, DNV, GL, LR, ABS, BV, NK, KR, CCS, RINA, RS, CCC, and GB.
advantages: Large-Scale Manufacturing Base: Accessen operates more than 100,000 square meters of manufacturing space across its Shanghai and Taicang facilities.
Dual Core Competence: The company emphasizes plate heat exchange technology and system integration as its core technical capabilities.
Broad Product Portfolio: Products cover plate heat exchangers, fully welded exchangers, process cooling systems, waste heat recovery systems, and prefabricated integrated cooling stations.
International Standards and Certifications: The company highlights compliance with ASME, CE, AHRI, API, DNV, GL, LR, ABS, BV, NK, KR, CCS, RINA, RS, CCC, and GB standards and certifications.
Extensive Service Coverage: Direct sales and service support covers major Chinese markets and selected overseas markets including Hong Kong, Singapore, Malaysia, and Thailand.
Proven Deployment Scale: Accessen states it has delivered solutions across more than 20,000 implementation cases and supports customers through a large service network.
